description: Lesson 04-24 (part 4V, fixed-form RPG IV, CRTBNDRPG): *ENTRY PLIST / CALL / PARM, PARM length mismatch, *PSSR, decimal data error, HEX(). Ports of the 04-08b experiments R0408BA..BG to ILE RPG (V0424A..G plus solutions V0424X/H/I/J/K/L), so the real ILE behaviour is recorded instead of assuming the OPM RPG III facts. PRECONDITION: the library (<USER>2) already holds the DBVER 1 sample database (TOKUIM has C00001 = ACME TRADING CO). ORDER: file steps create QRPGLESRC (RCDLEN 112) and upload all sources; CHGPFM sets SRCTYPE(RPGLE); every member is compiled with CRTBNDRPG DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) OPTION(*EVENTF) (event file copied to V24EVF so RNF ids and severities can be read; V24NA..V24ND are deliberately failing negative examples, V24PL is a probe whose success or failure is recorded); then CHGJOB INQMSGRPY(*DFT); then the calls. Every call is preceded by a marker row and followed by CPYSPLF of the QSYSPRT spool into V24SPL (and DLTSPLF so that *LAST cannot pick up a stale spool); collect step 1 lists V24SPL in order. Correct calls first (V0424B, V0424X, V0424K), then the *PSSR pair (V0424G with RETURN inside *PSSR, V0424I with ENDSR *CANCL), then V0424E (character mismatch), then the inquiry-message / hang-prone experiments LAST (V0424D, CL caller C0424A with &QTY 3,0, a bare numeric literal PARM(5 X) into the 5,0 PARM, a call with one PARM too few, and V0424L reading W0424B whose QTY holds five periods = invalid zoned decimal; HEX(QTY) is collected). The message text and default reply of RNQ0907/RNQ0202/RNX9001/RNX0100 are collected from QSYS2.MESSAGE_FILE_DATA (the view name and columns are unverified; failure of that collect is harmless). Nothing in this batch has been run on hardware yet (2026-10-01): every expected value in the lesson is a placeholder. Only the compile step of the library-less negative members can fail on purpose. Timeout: sshTimeoutMs is 600000 (compile-heavy: 18 CRTBNDRPG plus about 11 calls that may wait on inquiry replies or dumps; the default 180 s would lose VFYLOG). RUNONE (too few PARMs, writes through an unpassed parameter) is deliberately the very last call. If V24SPL comes back empty and VFYLOG shows CAPRUN* FAILED, the spool capture into an SQL table did not work: switch V24SPL to CRTPF RCDLEN(133) as in part06-0103-freeform.
